verdict.rationale: Raygun documents data-minimization controls: you can filter sensitive fields out of error payloads before they are sent, and an application setting can disable IP address storage. Neither is a retention or deletion control. Nothing in the evidence covers configurable retention periods or deleting stored error data. Missing for 10: configurable retention windows, user- or API-driven deletion of stored error/crash data, documented deletion or erasure workflows (e.g. GDPR requests), independent corroboration.
